sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: A UK ETS scheme year is a calendar year.
HSE emissions monitoring starts on 1 January.
The annual emissions report plus declaration or verification report is due by 31 March for the previous scheme year.
The guidance identifies July as the point to appoint an appropriate accredited verifier if applicable.
facts.expected_handling: Treat July as annual-cycle guidance, not invent another statutory date.

facts.source_fact: The guidance says December is a suitable time to begin preparing the annual emissions report.
Non-significant monitoring-plan changes made in the year must be notified by 31 December.
Emissions monitoring for the scheme year completes on 31 December.
Report submissions are made using METS.
HSE reportable emissions are monitored from 1 January through 31 December.
Failure to complete required annual-cycle tasks can lead to enforcement action and civil penalties.
facts.expected_handling: Do not overstate penalty as automatic unless specified.
